full_text:
Article 2 (Application for Designation of the Nuclear Safety Information Sharing Center)
① The application for designation of a Nuclear Safety Information Sharing Center, as stipulated in Article 3(3) of the "Act on the Disclosure and Communication of Nuclear Safety Information" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act"), excluding the portions specified in each item, shall be in Form No. 1.
② When the Nuclear Safety Committee, as stipulated in Article 3 of the "Act on the Establishment and Operation of the Nuclear Safety Committee" (hereinafter referred to as "the Nuclear Safety Committee"), designates a Nuclear Safety Information Sharing Center in accordance with Article 5(1) of the "Act on the Disclosure and Communication of Nuclear Safety Information" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act"), it shall issue a designation certificate in Form No. 2.
